_comment: PLACEHOLDER. No CNN input pipeline has been designed yet -- M2 (Implement CNN in PyTorch) hasn't started. crop == the full 320x240 frame, resize_to == crop size, i.e. currently a no-op. tools/visualize_camera_coverage.py and tools/camera_resolvability.py both read this file rather than hard-coding a crop, specifically so that once M2 decides the real crop/resize, both tools immediately reflect it just by editing this file and re-running them -- see the finding in the camera-projection verification PR about 'visible' vs 'visible to the network' being different predicates once this stops being a no-op.
